description: As part of join work between Atlas Axis and Core Facilitator teams, this pull request migrates the Atlas from HTML to Markdown. This allows us to express the full hierarchical structure of the Atlas and will support future automations and AI integrations that are under development.

prTitle: Atomic Atlas: decompose Sky Atlas.md into one-folder-per-document tree + sync tooling

diff: (CRR) with respect to one or more Instances is the Required Risk Capital with respect to such Instances divided by the amount of capital from Sky’s Collateral Portfolio invested in such Instances.

Risk Capital requirements in the Risk Framework may be specified either as an amount of RRC or as a CRR. If a CRR is specified, then the RRC is equal to the amount of capital from Sky’s Collateral Portfolio invested in the relevant Instances times the CRR.
